_note_short: short names the per-genome output files (batch.py writes <short>_attributes.jsonl), so it MUST be unique per genome and filename-safe. The three B73 assemblies are distinguished as maize/maize_v4/maize_v3 for exactly that reason: labelling them all 'maize' would make them write the same file, which is the same collision the base-taxon id used to cause in mongo_source.discover_genomes.
_note_taxon: taxon is documentation only -- discover_genomes derives it from mongo and matches these overrides by system_name. Values are the FULL per-genome taxon_ids used on this site, not NCBI base ids.

genomes._why_excluded: Animal outgroup. Taxon 7227 has no po_map.CLADE_OF_TAXON entry, so it falls to clade 'other', which has no CLADE_PANELS organ panel; and the plant stress classifier matches none of its contrasts. Measured on this site's own full run: 17,737 docs, breadth='no_baseline' for every one, and ZERO carrying a single non-empty attribute -- pure noise that would advertise an expression_attributes capability holding nothing. Contrast chlamydomonas: clade 'algae' also has 0 organs, but that is by design (algae and bryophytes are stress-only) and it does carry data -- 4,133 of 17,943 docs have stress attributes. So 0 organs alone is NOT the test for exclusion; 0 information is. Its raw `expression` docs are unaffected.
